answer: Farming becomes a harbor bet on surviving 52 epochs of grading, and every canyon settlement recomputes the nebula schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 52 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
